notes: Actual design has no NAT, ALB, RDS, CloudWatch, secret, customer KMS key or EBS snapshot resource.
AMI snapshot allowance is a conservative future artifact prerequisite, not provisioned by this configuration.
Backup versions may be billable about 14 days plus asynchronous lifecycle delay, not exactly seven.
Retained data volume and ECR/buckets require explicit reviewed deletion.
Bootstrap temporarily adds another 8GB root volume during instance replacement; no overlapping apps allowed.
